entries.title: Fixed Handheld Roll Label Applicator
entries.description: One original complete static handheld roll-label applicator. The integral sloped head and grounded rear grip carry a genuine front output slot, two upper roll supports and two lower nose-roller forks. A separate loaded paper-like annular roll sits around its full axle; the axle and small nose roller have full end seats in the forks. A fixed finger trigger meets the head underside and remains separate from the grip, while a short blank label tab rests in the output slot. Six closed editable meshes and three opaque untextured PBR materials. The visible roll core is occupied by its axle, not claimed as an unobstructed assembled through-hole. Static appearance only: no continuous hidden paper path, printed prices, glue, feed linkage, trigger travel, spring, working roller or manufacture is claimed. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal-bounds-centred grounded grip sole. New whole arrangement, not an extracted scanner grip, scaled stapler, desktop tape dispenser or colour variant.

entries.title: Rooftop Observing Platform
entries.description: One static rooftop-observing scene from the original astronomy scene program. A complete original tripod telescope occupies the left observing area, its separate complete observing chair sits behind it, and a complete star-chart console is beside the open front approach. One newly authored scene-only roof slab has three integral thick parapets and an open front access edge. All original local POSITION/NORMAL, materials and internal node transforms are retained at unit scale, with translation-only placement. One scene, zero new independent models. Fictional visual roof platform only: no stairs, building, fall protection, safe access, telescope-eye alignment, optical operation, tracking, astronomy data, load or installation certification.

entries.title: Fixed Three Curved-arm Sprinkler
entries.description: One newly authored static garden-sprinkler appearance: two low elongated feet and a bridge carry a short upright stem, thick open hub and three complete hollow round tubes sweeping outward with same-handed curved raised tips. Each tube has genuine finite wall thickness and open terminal bores; a separate side inlet sleeve completes the silhouette. Nine closed editable meshes, three constant opaque PBR materials. Not a resized Y-shaped open channel, capped tripod turnstile or hose reel. Internal fluid connections through the hub are not modeled or claimed; no water, rotating mechanism, flow, irrigation performance, manufacture or safety claim. Metres, Z up, true whole bounds-centred ground origin. One static game-art prop.

entries.title: Seven-Piece Tangram Gift Board
entries.description: One original static seven-piece tangram gift set in a recessed square wooden tray. The editable pieces are the actual two large right-isosceles triangles, one medium triangle, two small triangles, one square and one parallelogram, arranged as the familiar complete square with narrow real clearance seams. The tray is one closed solid body with a true open recess and full floor, not four loose rails. Eight closed meshes and four opaque matte solid PBR roles. New complete tray and exact flat partition, not an extracted track segment, multi-cell storage cubby, texture decal or colour variant of a published puzzle board. Metres, Z up, front -Y, centred horizontal bounds and full tray base at Z0. Every piece has a real finite lower face resting on the tray floor. One whole prop, not seven separately counted assets. Static display only; no animation, drag interactions, puzzle-solver, manufacturing, safety or physical-stability claim.

entries.title: Open-Corner Musical Triangle and Beater
entries.description: One complete fixed-display percussion gift: a continuous thick metal rod bent through two rounded corners into an open triangular instrument, with a real lower-right gap, plus its separate straight finite metal beater. Not a filled triangular plate, road sign, closed jewellery hoop, tambourine or a resized toy. Both newly authored closed editable solids rest on genuine finite faceted ground patches. Two opaque solid PBR metal roles. Metres, Z up, front -Y, horizontal bounds centred. The instrument is statically posed upright and the beater rests separately in front, not a functioning suspension or a claim of physical balance. No vibration, sound, striking, animation, manufacture, safety or stability claim. One whole instrument set, not two separately counted assets.
